verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a REST API for managing data and real-time BWA and dashboard reports. These are developer building blocks and adjacent reporting features, not a first-party agent that answers affordability questions from live ledger data. The probes found no llms.txt, Markdown docs or OpenAPI spec, and nothing in the pack shows a product-provided AI or agent interface for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API
